column1: # Documented web-parity residue, applied mechanically by web_parity.sh
# (apply_web_ledger) AFTER the crawl rows land. A DIFF/MISSING_* row whose file
# has a matching entry is rewritten to status LEDGERED and reported under this
# entry's class; a DIFF/MISSING_* row with NO entry is an undocumented
# divergence and FAILS the gate's verdict.
#            EXACTLY against column 1 of the results TSV - the same spelling
#   symptom  which row statuses this entry excuses:
#              DIFF | MISSING_RS | MISSING_HS   exactly that status
#              none                             excuses NOTHING; the entry only
#                                               documents a path that belongs to
#            An `any` entry shadows every narrower entry for the same path, so
#            give each entry the narrowest symptom its evidence supports: a
#            file-wide entry for a documented DIFF would silently swallow a
#   note     free prose, no tabs. Carry the evidence: how many rows the entry
#            excused when it was written, and in which sweep.
# web_parity.sh reports entries that excuse nothing, and each report fails the
# verdict - an entry that excuses nothing today is a mask waiting for the file
#   LEDGER-STALE      the file WAS compared this run and no row of it matched
#                     the entry. The residue is gone (or changed symptom): drop
#   LEDGER-SHADOWED   a narrower entry sits under an `any` entry for the same
#                     path, so it can never match.
#   LEDGER-UNMATCHED  the path is not in the corpus at all. Checked against
#                     CORPUS_ROOT rather than against this run, so it is
#                     reported however small the run's ALLOWLIST is.
# Entries whose path this run simply did not crawl are counted, not reported:
# a 2-file smoke run must not read as 77 dead entries. `none` entries are
# A malformed line (wrong column count, unknown symptom, duplicate path+symptom)
# aborts the gate BEFORE it crawls anything.
#   witness-index  Identical proof states rendered with different internal
#                  goal-creation numbers, term-abbreviation picks - on AC-heavy
#                  theories. Cosmetic: never reaches proof scripts, proof
#                  structure or verdicts. Upstream numbering/eq-store class,
#   proof-path     The two autoproofs reach the same verdict along DIFFERENT
#                  case paths, so the site maps harvested from the proved
#                  theory carry different node URLs and pair as MISSING_*
#                  rather than as page divergence. Same underlying numbering
#                  class as witness-index, seen through the URL space.
#   watch          No divergence observed at the baseline. The entry exists so
#                  the path stays enumerated with the rest of the residue set;
#                  it excuses nothing, so any divergence on these files fails
# ef3f0468, 86 files / 69,615 rows). Every symptom and count below is read off
# that sweep; the 77 paths are the set websweep_residual.txt enumerates.
